content.scenario: The State Government of Maharashtra wants to establish more than one District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in the district of Mumbai.
content.outcome: The State Government of Maharashtra may establish more than one District Commission in the district of Mumbai if it deems fit, by issuing a notification.

user_queries: Can a State Government establish multiple District Commissions?
What is the process for establishing multiple District Commissions?
Is notification required for establishing multiple District Commissions?
